plugin.note: Rogues have 0 magic and 0 ranged defence, so ranged or magic is fastest; their crush defence (+11) is highest. Rogues' Castle is deep north-east Wilderness with the Chaos Elemental nearby - bring only cheap gear.

requirements: Kills must be made in the Wilderness to count for the Krystilia assignment.
No Slayer level or quest requirement.
Deep north-east Wilderness travel with high PKer and Chaos Elemental risk.
mechanics: The level 15 Rogue (npc 526) has 17 Hitpoints, grants 17 Slayer XP, and has defence level 13.
Magic and ranged defences are 0; crush (+11) is highest.
A level 135 Rogue variant (npc 6603) also exists; its stats are UNKNOWN here.
The Chaos Elemental in the castle courtyard can attack through walls.

methods.label: Ranged
methods.summary: Kill the Rogues' Castle rogues with ranged against their 0 ranged defence.
steps: Travel to Rogues' Castle in the deep north-east Wilderness.
Attack the rogues with ranged (or magic).
Watch for the Chaos Elemental and PKers.
notes: Bring only cheap gear; deep Wilderness carries high risk.

methods.label: Magic
methods.summary: Cast against the rogues' 0 magic defence for fast, accurate kills.
steps: Travel to Rogues' Castle in the deep north-east Wilderness.
Attack the rogues with magic (0 magic defence).
Watch for the Chaos Elemental and PKers.
notes: Ranged is equally effective given their 0 ranged defence.
